name: Lilith + Eve
source:
A short Garden of Eden-inspired story about Adam who chases after angels, Eve who can’t find her place in Elysium, and a lesser demon of the lilitu species - Lilith. 

[from [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/lilith-eve]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个受伊甸园启发的短篇故事，讲述了追逐天使的亚当、在极乐世界中找不到自己位置的夏娃以及莉莉图族中的小恶魔莉莉丝。

[来自[url=https://pdrr.itch.io/lilith-eve]itch.io[/url]]
